name: d3d8to9
summary: Lightweight DirectX 8 to DirectX 9 API shim. Required prerequisite for HelixMod fixes on DirectX 8 games, converting DX8 calls to DX9 so that the d3d9.dll HelixMod hook can intercept them. Drop-in DLL.
compatibility_notes: DX8 games only. For DX9 games, dgVoodoo2 or direct HelixMod injection is used instead.
